# Skills

Which skill serves which task. What triggers a skill stands in its `description`, and only there; this table is
its copy for reading. Skills marked "maintainer" are typed by the maintainer and never started by the model.

| Skill | What it does | Started by |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [code](skills/code/SKILL.md) | Build one approved Jira card: work package, the plan's order step by step, full gate, every card line ticked, independent review, pull request, Done after the merge. Use when the maintainer orders the build of a card; without an implementation plan nothing is built unless the card type is plan-free. | model |
| [comment-audit](skills/comment-audit/SKILL.md) | Run the comment rule set of ADR 0005 over every existing file, put the counts per area on the cleanup card and clear the areas one by one. Use when existing comments are to be cleaned up or someone asks how large the backlog is — not for single files, which the gate checks on every write anyway. | model |
| [decision-sheet](skills/decision-sheet/SKILL.md) | Build a decision sheet for the maintainer as an interactive artifact — findings with sources, only real questions with my own recommendation, answers collected in its store. Use whenever input, an approval or a decision from the maintainer is needed, instead of asking in chat. | model |
| [implementation-plan](skills/implementation-plan/SKILL.md) | Turn one Jira card into the plan that the code skill builds — inventory of what exists, placement, steps that each end green, test plan, and the card's acceptance verbatim. Use when the maintainer orders the plan for a card. No code. | model |
| [pickup](skills/pickup/SKILL.md) | At the start of a session without an order, read the board and propose exactly one card to work on, with the reason. Use when the maintainer says "what is next" or "continue", or a session starts without a concrete order. | model |
| [plan](skills/plan/SKILL.md) | Turn an order of the maintainer into a product plan and its Jira cards — what is built and why, not how. Use when the maintainer orders a product plan. Ends with the cards created; the plan is done then. | model |
| [push](skills/push/SKILL.md) | The maintainer's approval to push a feature branch, as a window of 30 minutes by default. Only the maintainer types it; the model cannot give itself the approval, and main stays locked either way. | maintainer |
| [review](skills/review/SKILL.md) | Check and judge in two modes — with a diff against its card and the rules, ending in mergeable or not; without a diff as a scan over a named area, ending in a report on a decision sheet. Use when the maintainer orders a review. Fixes only what the maintainer orders. | model |
| [ticket](skills/ticket/SKILL.md) | Create, read, maintain or close a Jira card on PIX so that it outlives the session. Use before anything is written through the Atlassian connector and at every status change. | model |
| [unblock](skills/unblock/SKILL.md) | The maintainer's named escape from the work-package rule. Opens 45 minutes in which writes to protected paths pass without a package, each reporting the reason. Only the maintainer types it, always with a reason. | maintainer |
